description: SUBJECT-FIRST routing: use battle=all to discover the supported Canadian immigration subjects, exact topic keys and public guide links. Select one listed key for current official-source navigation, the licensed topic expert and source-classified educational evidence. For verification dates, effective-date changes and dated findings, use get_mak_change_ledger; for published expert articles, use get_mak_published_source_guides; for explicitly requested human contact, use get_mak_rcic_contact. General read-only navigation, not an eligibility, work authorization, evidence sufficiency or outcome determination.

battle.description: all = compact public topic directory for exploratory queries; otherwise choose the exact user source-navigation intent: spousal_pfl = spousal sponsorship, relationship evidence, or spousal-specific procedural fairness letter; business_financial = business immigration, source of funds, or financial evidence; cec_work_evidence = Canadian Experience Class employment or work-experience evidence; express_entry_review = Express Entry file or evidence review; pr_card_residency = in-Canada PR-card renewal and residency-obligation source navigation; bowp_in_canada = BOWP application and status source navigation for workers in Canada; pfl_response = standalone PFL and misrepresentation concerns with the controlling actual IRCC letter; employer_hiring_imp = Canadian employer LMIA-exempt IMP and Employer Portal navigation; maintained_work_rights = maintained-status work conditions, work-permit extension and changing employers while an application is pending; super_visa_income = Super Visa parent/grandparent host-income requirements; spousal_trv_dual_intent = sponsored spouse/partner visitor visa, dual intent under IRPA 22(2), IRPR 179 and separate work-permit eligibility; in_canada_worker_pr_initiatives = 2026-2027 old 33,000-worker PR inventory acceleration versus the separate announced 2027 time-limited workers measure; spousal_pr_aor_completeness = spousal permanent residence completeness/AOR; ee_settlement_funds = Express Entry proof of funds; citizenship_by_descent_2025 = citizenship by descent law; ee_2026_high_wage_lmi = Express Entry high-wage and LMIA changes; worker_restore_status = worker restoration; foreign_worker_family_owp = foreign worker family open work permit categories.
